name: Paul Heinze
bio: Paul Heinze, a Bismarck surveyor, finished resurveying the Medora town-plat in May 1885, finding the earlier survey off by six inches to four feet. In September 1885 he surveyed the scene of the shooting in which Luffsey was killed and showed his sketch at the trial, while cowboys passing by mistook his transit for a camera and posed for him.

moments.label: Completed survey of the Medora town-plat

mentions: The survey of the town-plat is completed and Mr. Heinze returned to Bismarck, Monday. It was found that the previous survey was from six inches to four feet out of the way.
Paul Heinze, of Bismarck, was here Tuesday, surveying the scene of the shooting affray in which Luffsey was killed. His survey will be submitted to the jury.
…Medora, now at Jamestown, came in Sunday. He is a witness in the Luffsey murder case and accompanied surveyor Heinze here.
